enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed with eyes closed. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Remain still. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Stretch legs. Turn onto back. Place arms at sides. Continue sleeping. Remain motionless.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wipe eyes. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply soap. Rinse face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Turn off light.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs. Turn on stove. Cook eggs in pan. Transfer eggs to plate. Sit at table. Eat breakfast.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing bag for the work shift
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt and pants. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open backpack. Place stethoscope inside. Zip backpack.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Read messages. Arrive at hospital stop. Stand up. Walk to bus door. Exit bus. Walk to hospital entrance. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, providing patient care and attending to clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Change into scrubs. Attend handover meeting. Receive patient assignments. Walk to patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Record temperature. Administer medication. Update patient chart. Assist doctor with procedure. Talk to patient's family. Walk to nurses' station. Answer phone. Take notes. Attend lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to ward. Check on patients.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Read messages. Arrive at home stop. Stand up. Walk to bus door. Exit bus. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cabinet. Take out cutting board and knife. Close cabinet. Chop vegetables. Cut meat. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Cook. Turn off stove. Transfer food to plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Turn on light. Walk to sofa. Sit down. Pick up remote control. Press power button. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Put remote down. Pick up magazine. Flip pages. Put magazine down. Pick up remote again. Change channel. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get glass of water. Return to sofa.

enriched_activities.activity: Loading and running the washing machine for laundry
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Open washing machine door. Pick up laundry basket. Place clothes into washing machine. Close door. Open detergent drawer. Pour detergent. Close drawer. Press power button. Select cycle. Press start button. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer to catch up on messages and read
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Walk to desk. Sit on chair. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for login screen. Type password. Press enter. Open email client. Read emails. Reply to email. Open messaging app. Read messages. Type reply. Send message. Open web browser. Read news article. Scroll down. Close browser. Open document.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Dry body with towel. Put on pajamas.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting out clothes and winding down before sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on light. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt and pants. Place on chair. Close wardrobe. Open drawer. Take out underwear. Place on chair. Turn off light. Lie on bed. Close eyes.

Lie in bed with eyes closed. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Remain still. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Stretch legs. Turn onto back. Place arms at sides. Continue sleeping. Remain motionless.
